title: Captain Ratax's Vanilla Modpack
description: Just the modpack I normally use on my Vanilla Minecraft Server.
body:
A vanilla-friendly modpack built around the way I like to play on vanilla servers, with a focus on visuals, ambience, performance, quality of life, and a cleaner overall experience.

It keeps the core Minecraft feeling, while making the game smoother, prettier, and more immersive.

### Links
- [captainratax.pt](https://captainratax.pt/)

## Highlights

### Performance
Improves FPS, chunk loading, memory usage, and overall game smoothness.

### Visuals
Adds better animations, lighting, particles, weather, entity models, and extra polish without changing the vanilla feel too much.

### Quality of Life
Includes useful UI improvements, inventory tools, map utilities, building helpers, and other client-side conveniences.

### Audio & Atmosphere
Enhances ambient sounds, footsteps, drips, music notifications, and subtle environmental effects.
